# Mamdouh Aboammar

> Vibe coder, conversion copywriter, and founder of PrePilot LLC. Building autonomous agentic tooling, conversion infrastructure, and developer quality gates.

## Overview
Mamdouh Aboammar is a developer, conversion copywriter, and founder based in Dubai and the United Arab Emirates. His technical systems focus on agent governance, frontend quality gates, autonomous coding workflows, and high-performance conversion infrastructure.

## Core Projects & Flagship Systems
- [PrePilot LLC](https://prepilot-system-agency.space/): Conversion infrastructure and AI agent systems for the MENA region.
- [Agent Kernel](https://github.com/imMamdouhaboammar/agent-kernel): Multi-agent orchestration kernel, policy engine, and deterministic agent execution framework.
- [AOS - Antigravity Omni-Agentic Superplatform](https://github.com/imMamdouhaboammar/aos): Dual-loop cognitive orchestrator with AST blast-radius checking and verification gates.
- [Fable Code Lifecycle](https://github.com/imMamdouhaboammar/get-fable): Bounded, evidence-based coding lifecycle for autonomous agents.
- [Taste-Skill Suite](https://github.com/imMamdouhaboammar/taste-skill): Anti-slop design system enforcement, eliminating AI visual tropes and em-dashes.
- [Stop-Slop](https://github.com/imMamdouhaboammar/stop-slop): Linter and pattern analyzer eradicating predictable AI writing tropes from software copy.

## Verification & Documentation
- [Interactive Portfolio Engine](https://immamdouhaboammar.github.io/imMamdouhaboammar/): Live interactive catalog of all 142 repositories with search, filters, and clone commands.
- [Complete Repositories Catalog](https://immamdouhaboammar.github.io/imMamdouhaboammar/REPOSITORIES.md): Detailed markdown catalog organized into 10 specialized categories.
- [Extended Knowledge Base](https://immamdouhaboammar.github.io/imMamdouhaboammar/llms-full.txt): Complete repository manifests, snippets, and architecture notes.

## Crown Jewels & Flagship Systems

Highlighted architectural systems, production platforms, and foundational agent engines.

### [agent-kernel](https://github.com/imMamdouhaboammar/agent-kernel)
- **Access & Tech:** `Public` | `JavaScript` | `1 stars`
- **Description:** Local governance, memory, failure lessons, and architecture guardrails for Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, Gemini CLI, and other AI coding agents.
- **Facts with Funny Wordplaying:** *The only kernel where memory leaks get a lifetime restraining order and hallucinating agents are legally required to show identification.*
- **Why I Crafted / Contributed In:** LLMs kept giving themselves root access in terminal sessions and forgetting user constraints after 10 turns. Built as an immutable constitutional governance layer.
- **Historical Context & Snippets:** TypeScript CLI and runtime enforcing local memory, trust boundaries, tool permissions, and failure playbooks across Claude Code, Cursor, Codex, and Gemini CLI.

### [conversion-copywriting-engine](https://github.com/imMamdouhaboammar/conversion-copywriting-engine)
- **Access & Tech:** `Public` | `Markdown/Text` | `1 stars`
- **Description:** Complete conversion copywriting operating system for Claude. Supports TTPM, FAB&M, Persuasion Cards, TOF/MOF/BOF messaging, and CRO quality gates.
- **Facts with Funny Wordplaying:** *Turns 'Click here to submit' into an offer so seductive your visitors apologize for not buying sooner.*
- **Why I Crafted / Contributed In:** Standard LLM copywriting is robotic fluff that converts at 0.3%. High-converting direct response copy requires emotional tension, objection demolition, and cultural nuance.
- **Historical Context & Snippets:** Complete conversion copywriting operating system for Claude and Gemini, complete with objection maps, pain-point hooks, and MENA dialect adapters.

### [delegate-team](https://github.com/imMamdouhaboammar/delegate-team)
- **Access & Tech:** `Public` | `Python` | `4 stars`
- **Description:** Agentic engineering supersystem - one CLI to run the full /mavis-ship chain. Bundles 38 curated integrations + 1890 skills + the v2.7.1 arsenal (orchestrate.py + catalog.py + autopilot + mavis-ship-uni + big-boss persona). MIT.
- **Facts with Funny Wordplaying:** *Why hire a 10-person dev team when you can summon 10 specialized AI agents and watch them aggressively peer-review each other's pull requests?*
- **Why I Crafted / Contributed In:** Single agent context windows degrade when one agent tries to be the backend architect, security auditor, tester, and copywriter at the same time. Delegate-team routes tasks across specialized subagents.
- **Historical Context & Snippets:** One unified CLI to run the entire /matrix of specialized agents with isolated worktrees, curated tools, and an end-to-end automated shipping chain.

### [dokion](https://github.com/imMamdouhaboammar/dokion)
- **Access & Tech:** `Public` | `TypeScript` | `1 stars`
- **Description:** Cross-agent security & quality hardening engine for Claude Code, Codex, and Gemini CLI. Enforces user-authored playbooks, verifiable evidence gates, and auditable readiness reports.
- **Facts with Funny Wordplaying:** *The strict nightclub bouncer of your codebase: checking every agent's ID, denying hallucinated packages, and kicking out suspicious shell scripts.*
- **Why I Crafted / Contributed In:** AI coding agents frequently execute dangerous commands or install obsolete packages. Dokion injects real-time security sandboxing and AST validation.
- **Historical Context & Snippets:** Cross-agent security and quality hardening engine for Claude Code, Cursor, and Gemini CLI.

### [get-fable](https://github.com/imMamdouhaboammar/get-fable)
- **Access & Tech:** `Public` | `TypeScript` | `3 stars`
- **Description:** Make the model you already use work more like a frontier model with better planning, persistent context, skills, hooks, failure handling, and verification
- **Facts with Funny Wordplaying:** *Turns a budget LLM into a skeptical, tea-drinking senior principal engineer who questions your architectural sanity before touching a single line.*
- **Why I Crafted / Contributed In:** Autonomous agents fail when they rush straight into code edits without discovery. Fable forces deterministic lifecycle phases and circuit-breakers.
- **Historical Context & Snippets:** 7-phase coding lifecycle: Discovery, Research, Red-Green-Refactor, AST Telepathy, 3-Pass Verification, and Release with zero regression tolerance.
